storyInfo: A Rhodes Island team will soon deploy to Ursus. Folinic asks Mudrock to help organize a party. At the same time, it seems she has an announcement to make.

attributes.content: Watch out.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Whoa!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Phew... Thanks. There's so many reports in this pile, I just can't stack them right.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Huh? Mudrock? You're back!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: How long has it been since you left on your field mission? A month?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Yup, the mission dragged on for a while, but I can finally get some rest now.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Dr. Folinic, um, if you don't mind me saying... you don't look very well.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Really? Maybe I've had a little too much coffee the last couple days.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Are you sure you're not pushing yourself too hard?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Not at all. Things have been a little busier than usual, though.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: We are putting together a team to deploy to Ursus. Everyone on the ship is as busy as could be.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Oh, I guess it's not a landship anymore... I mean the HQ, but I guess you know that, right?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Yeah. Ursus?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: We'll get a proper announcement soon. I guess I can just tell you.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Amiya and the Doctor are planning to lead an elite team to Ursus.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: No wonder everyone seemed so busy when I got back...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: In that case, I'll—
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Wait, Mudrock.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Um... Are you free right now?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: What's the matter?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I need a hand. I want to throw a party in the canteen.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: A party?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Yes, I want to invite a couple friends who'll be going to Ursus.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: What does that have to do with me?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I told you, I need a helping hand.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Dr. Folinic... I'm sure I don't need to remind you how we got off to a rocky start...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Are you sure I'm the right one? Do you really want me to help you with your party?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You remember what happened in Wolumonde, don't you?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I remember. I remember it all. I wanted to medicate myself, at the time...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You really don't know how to sugarcoat things, do you?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Nothing's changed. Even though you didn't hurt anybody, if your Originium Arts ever go berserk and put Rhodes Island in harm's way, know that I will take any necessary measures against you, without hesitation.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I believe you.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: So I ask again... Why me?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: It's because we don't know each other that well, or rather... because we once stood against one another... that I think this is our best chance to get to clear the air.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: ...Alright.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: What are we looking for?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: A box. It should have my name on it... Come to think of it, this is really strange.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: We've been working for the same company for years now.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You're the one who convinced me to stay...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I hesitated before, too. I asked myself if I could really live under the same roof with you people.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: And before I knew it, time flew so fast.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Have you found the answer, then?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Not yet, but at the very least, I didn't really think about it at all, when I invited you to join us.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Found it. Right here.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Give it, I'll carry that.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: What's this?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Some things I brought to Rhodes Island with me when I joined. I took them to a branch office they sent me to. Thinking back, that might've been some kind of omen.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I never told you how I ended up at Rhodes Island, did I?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I think you did. You mentioned Dr. Kal'tsit sent somebody to Ursus to bring you here.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Right, Rhodes Island had just been formed, and it wasn't until some time after, when the Chernobog operation took place.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I'd heard that Dr. Kal'tsit was coming to get me. I thought I knew where we were going, so I grabbed all kinds of things that turned out to be pretty useless. Like this—
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Is this... an Ursine portable Originium stove?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Could you take it apart for me? I want to see if the spray head inside can still be used.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: This model is pretty old.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Rhodes Island's standard-issue Originium electric heating module is only one-third its size, but it's twice as effective.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I want to make a soup with this.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Why do you insist on using it?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Have you ever been to the Ursine tundra?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I've heard stories of the place. It's a land of death where even Originium Arts are frozen.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: That's right. In the extreme cold, those precise machines become unreliable.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: When the temperature drops below minus fifty, when the Originium storms kill all electrical circuits...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Your life depends on these ugly, cumbersome things that burn liquefied Originium.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: When I was a kid, I couldn't stand the stench. The fumes always made me tear up.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: But now... they put my mind at ease.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Because as long as the fire is still lit, it means I haven't been devoured by the snowy white hell.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You seem pretty particular when it comes to the stove. There's probably more to this whole thing than just cooking soup?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Of course.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I need to make sure it will light up in one go, no hiccups.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Sure, it's still full of energy.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Just like Mother used to be, all those years ago.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Too bad, I'm not nearly as brave as she was.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: At the very least... you had the courage to stand against the rioters of Wolumonde.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: That wasn't courage. That was recklessness. Dr. Kal'tsit said that only those who survive can speak of courage.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You know what, Mudrock? Rhodes Island's heaters might be efficient, but there's always something missing, when you cook with them.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: The slightly smokey flavor, with the broth brought to a boil in the raging flames, bringing out the meat's aroma...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: That's the taste of home.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: The place where Amiya's team is going, that's real, true cold.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I want them enjoy hot soup, cooked on a stove like this, while they're camping out in the wilderness.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Even when they're out in a snowstorm, I want them to know that... their home is right there with them.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: The taste of home...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: (You want everyone on the team to have hot soup while they're out in the wilderness?)
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: (No, you need to ensure that it'll function, even in unsurvivable environments.)
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: (Are you doing this for them, or are you doing this for yourself?)
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: What's the matter?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Nothing.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Okay. We tested the fire. It's working perfectly.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Come. Onto our next stop.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Aside from food, we need to prepare a little surprise for our guests tonight.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Your room is a lot messier than I imagined.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Can't be helped. I just don't have the energy to clean up.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I can help you.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Forget it. Every time I put in the effort, I end up not being able to find my things.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: These clay dolls... are cleaning up for me?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I don't like untidy spaces.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: *sigh...*
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Hm?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I'm just thinking that you and I really don't get along.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Still though, thanks.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Let me know if you need housekeeping in the future.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Forget it. Let's have your clay dolls help me pack.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Pack what? Are these... gift boxes?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Something like that. I'm planning on holding a raffle at the party.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Wait. A raffle?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Yes. It's a party after all. You need something for the attendees to look forward to.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: And everyone invited to the party is on the team getting deployed. Amiya, the Doctor, and a few other operators.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I'm hoping to give them some gifts that'll actually be useful during their trip, but if I gave them to them outright...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You know how Amiya is. She'd say, 'You should keep it and use it yourself, Folinic.' The Doctor would definitely say 'We should prioritize distributing resources to those who need them'.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: So you're using the raffle as an excuse to give them these things?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Right. If they're just prizes they win in a game of chance, they probably won't say no.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Mudrock, could you get me the boxes with the ribbons on the table there? Right, those ones.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: A lot of craftsmanship went into the boxes' decoration.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: What do you think of this? How's the ribbon?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: It's beautiful, but what's inside? It seems pretty heavy.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Look inside. That's tonight's top prize.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Is this... a notebook?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: 'Research Notes on Originium Arts and Herbalism'... and 'First Aid Manual in the Ursine Extreme Cold'?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Did you write these yourself?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Yes, they are the sum total of everything I learned from Dr. Kal'tsit over the last few years, my own research on the special cases in Wolumonde...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: ...and... what I built on top of my mother's research.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: To a doctor, this is the most precious thing in all the lands.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: These notes are like a weapon and life itself. And you want to... turn them into a giveaway prize?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I do.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: But if you give them away, what about you?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You still need to work on your research and treat patients. Without these notes, your work will be a lot harder.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: It's okay.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I probably... won't have any need for them for a long while.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I don't have the energy to work on research this intricate anymore.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: They'll be putting them to far greater use in Ursus than I ever could by keeping them here for myself.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: What do you mean, you have no need for them anymore?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I mean, I work on other things now.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Look at everything scattered all over the room. These past few days, I've been thinking... the living actually don't need so many things.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Like these books, this equipment, and this old coat that I've so gotten used to wearing...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: If I can't take them along, keeping them here would just be more things to worry about.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: In that case, I might as well give them people who actually need them. That way, even if I'm not around, these things can still be put to good use.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: What's wrong?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Nothing, never mind. Let's start packing.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: That's the last of it.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Thanks for the help, Mudrock.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Don't worry about it.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Are we all done, then? In that case, I'll—
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Just a moment.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: There's one more favor I want to ask of you.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Could you... help me deliver an invitation?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: An invitation? To who?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: To you, and all your companions who came with you to Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: So you asked me to help because you were planning to invite us all along?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Maybe.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Well...?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: We've gone on plenty of missions together over the past few years.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I had nothing against you, even back in Wolumonde.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: But at the time, they were your enemy.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Even now at Rhodes Island, they've been instinctively avoiding you, worried about confrontation.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I know. Of course I can tell.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: My memories of my time there... are filled with fire and fury. There was a time when I even wanted to purge this place of every last one of them.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: But that's also why I want them at the party.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Because there's something I'll announce that has to do with them, too.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Mudrock, there are way too unknowns in this operation. There's no telling when everyone will be back.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I want to have a chat with them before they leave.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I don't want to... have any regrets about this.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: No regrets, huh...?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: That's right.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: There are things that I may never get the chance to tell them, if I don't do it now.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: If we've reached the point where we can set aside our differences, then I hope we can face this together candidly.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Here's a bottle of Leithanian wine. I've treasured it for a long time.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I was saving it for Dr. Kal'tsit's return... We would've enjoyed it together... to celebrate her homecoming.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: But now, I think there's a much better place for it to go.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Tell them, I hope they will come to tonight's party. I have some very good wine for them.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Dr. Folinic...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You even brought out your most prized possession.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Because it's worth it.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Okay, now go talk to them. I need to head to the cafeteria for the final preparations.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I have to personally watch the fire as the soup cooks.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You light the fire so they can find that last bit of hope to survive in the extreme cold.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You aren't doing this to make soup. You're trying to survive the Ursine tundra yourself. You want to carry that heavy stove to go on the run like your mother once did.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You're raffling those notes off to say goodbye to your past.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You're giving up your identity as a doctor and giving away your life's work. You're even worried they might not accept your work if you hand it to them directly, so you're turning it into a raffle.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: And this bottle of wine... and an invitation to your old enemies...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You're doing this to shrug off the hatred and regrets that have been plaguing your mind.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Dr. Folinic, I think I have a good idea of what kind of announcement you're going to make...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: If that's the path you've chosen, then I should probably do something for you too.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: The room's light has been tuned to a warm orange glow, and its walls are adorned with simple ribbon decorations.
There is steam floating out of a few large pots. The aroma of borscht wafts through the whole space.
The operators are gathered in small groups, and although each of them looks visibly exhausted, the hot food is proving to be an excellent source of comfort.
Thanks, Folinic... This soup is really good. It warms me up.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: That's great to hear, Amiya. Have some more.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Winters in Ursus last a long while. Remember this taste, okay? This is the flavor of Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Dr. Folinic...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Oh? Mudrock, you're here.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Your friends are here too, and look how happy they all seem. Thank you.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: What's wrong? You seem a little hesitant. Do you want some, too? I left you a bit of extra meat. It's right in the pot, kept warm on the stove.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Okay.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Well, now that you're here, I guess it's time to make my announcement.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Allow me.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: What are you doing?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I know what it is you want to tell everyone.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You've got arrangements for everything and everyone, except yourself.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Mudrock?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You brought out a stove that can be used in the extreme cold, without any care for efficiency, to reminisce about your mother.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You're raffling off your notes, to sever your ties.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You invited your old enemies here, giving them even your precious wine, to leave no regrets.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You're making arrangements.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I know you want to go to Ursus. You want to get revenge. You want to trade your life for Dr. Kal'tsit's.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I can see that none of the preparations you're making point to survival. This is all about destruction.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You don't want to be a burden to anyone, so you're giving away everything you have.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: But I can't accept that.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Since you've already decided, I won't stop you.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: But those things are too heavy. You can't carry them all by yourself.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I'll watch those things you can't take.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I'll watch over our Rhodes Island for you.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Now go. Do what it is that you want to do.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Um... Mudrock? Are you sure you aren't misunderstanding something?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Stop! Time out!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Sorry, everyone. Everything's fine. This is just... a little miscommunication between me and Mudrock.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Mudrock, step outside with me. Immediately. Right now.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Phew... Shouldn't be anyone here. Mudrock, seriously... you're way overthinking this!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Are all Sarkaz so imaginative?!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Overthinking? Everything you've prepared... and what you said...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Listen to me, Mudrock. Take a deep breath and let me explain.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: First, the stove is for Amiya's team!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: They'll be camping outside, and Rhodes Island's electric heaters aren't reliable in the extreme cold. I don't want them to freeze to death before they even make it to Ursus!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I dug it out so Amiya can enjoy some hot soup at night, so they can feel the warmth of home!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Wait... It's for Amiya? You aren't going to carry that there with you?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Why would I even do that? I wouldn't be able to run with that thing!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Second, the notes that I'm giving out...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: It's because Dr. Warfarin just gave me a promotion!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I'll be dealing with administrative reports forever, plus a whole shipload of medical personnel. I won't have time for any research!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: That's why I wanted to take this chance to organize everything I've learned and hand it over to the team that's leaving for Ursus.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Third, I didn't invite your friends because I wanted to bury the hatchet or anything like that!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You didn't?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Of course not!
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I'm staying here to hold the fort! You know how much of the base's defense force has been assigned away.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Amiya's leaving, along with a few elite operators, and Dr. Kal'tsit's not here.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Rhodes Island will be very vulnerable.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: You and your team will be a vital defensive asset.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I'll be fighting alongside all of you to protect this place we call home.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: If I keep putting on airs and giving them the cold shoulder, how are we supposed to band together when the enemy comes attacking?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: But...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Are you not going?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Amiya and the Doctor are going. You're Dr. Kal'tsit's protege. You have more reason than any of them to go.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: You hate Ursus so much, and you miss your mother so deeply...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Actually, Amiya asked me if I wanted to come.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: She offered to let me join the team when they were putting the roster together.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Then you...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I turned her down.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Why did you turn her down?
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I'm aware of my weakness.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: My Arts and combat skills are of very limited use on a battlefield of that level.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: If I'd accepted, I'd only be a burden to the rest of the team. I don't want them to have to protect me, even while everyone's focused on their mission.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Folinic... you're selling yourself short.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: No, I'm speaking objectively.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I despise Ursus. That's not going to change. Ever.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I used to think that, by making my way back and killing all my enemies there, I'd get my revenge, but Dr. Kal'tsit taught me that vengeance isn't the only fuel that drives our two feet.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: The longer I've lived at Rhodes Island, the more I've felt just how much blood and sweat Dr. Kal'tsit poured into this place.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: It's my wish that, by the time she comes back, the Rhodes Island she sees won't be any different from the one she left.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: When the time comes, I'll proudly walk over to her, and tell her that I played a part in keeping this place the same as it ever was.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: And you will have played a part, too.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Okay.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Alright, so, I guess we've cleared up that misunderstanding, then?
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: They're waiting for us in the canteen.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: If you'll stay here and be Rhodes Island's anchor...
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Then I'll stay, too.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I'll be a shield. Leave our security to me.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: I'll make sure my guys fall in line. They'll be the firmest line of defense.
attributes.name: Mudrock

attributes.content: Pff...
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: I'm counting on you, then. It's reassuring to have you around.
attributes.name: Folinic

attributes.content: Okay, let's head back. The borscht is getting cold.
